decision.explanation: The question asks for the spouse of Thomas Duckett. Two distinct individuals—Jerry White and Jane Bunce—are mentioned as spouses in separate documents. Document d1 (D1S3, D1S8) identifies Jerry White as the spouse of Thomas Duckett, while document d2 (D2S4, D2S9) identifies Jane Bunce as the spouse. These are two separate historical figures linked to two different Thomas Ducketts—one from the 17th century and one born in 1955. Since both claims are independently supported and refer to distinct individuals, both answers are valid and should be retained.
